findings.failure_path: OwnedInputStream._close currently omits ignore_errors=False. A PortAudio failure can therefore be suppressed by the real public wrapper, after which this owner clears its stream, sets CLOSED and returnsTrue. begin_close then completes and global mute has no remaining native operation to count. findings.retry_contract: begin_close retries _close when it returnsFalse. Because installed sounddevice.close nulls its pointer even on strict error, blindly retrying that same wrapper is not an independent native exit receipt. The next unit must preserve unknown/noACK instead of accepting a later empty/idempotent close.
